name: Loan and Mortgage Fraud
description: Applicants or insiders misstate income, assets, identity or property value to obtain credit, or use straw buyers and inflated appraisals. Mortgage fraud may involve collusion with brokers, valuers or conveyancers.

sources.text: FinCEN, advisories on mortgage and real-estate fraud (general)
FATF, guidance on real-estate sector risks (general)
ACFE, Occupational Fraud 2024: A Report to the Nations (2024)
